name: Banh canh
summary: Banh canh cá lóc is a thick-noodle soup with snakehead fish. The noodles are cut wide and the broth is the meal, closer to a Hue bowl than to mi Quang.
origin: Central Vietnam. Da Nang eats the Hue-style snakehead bowl, often at a shop that prints Huế on the sign.
howToEat: Eat it with a spoon. The noodles are too wide to toss the way you toss mi Quang.
Add chili if you want heat. The fish should taste clean, not muddy.
Come hungry. A bowl is a full lunch.
where: Huế Thu is on Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế. The page has the street and not a house number, so confirm the door when you arrive.
In Dong Hoi the everyday bowl is cháo canh. Du khách on 15 Mar 2023 also calls that bowl bánh canh. The noodles, the ram, and the broth are not this Da Nang snakehead bowl.
priceBand: A shop bowl is an everyday lunch.
seoTitle: Banh canh ca loc — Da Nang snakehead noodles
seoDescription: Banh canh ca loc is snakehead fish in a thick noodle broth. In Da Nang, order it at Hue Thu on Chau Thi Vinh Te and eat the bowl with a spoon at lunch.
